ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 24
   C. 2
   D. 25

2. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 18
   C. 9
   D. 81

3. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 400

4. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 121
   C. 122
   D. 11

5. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 5
   C. 7
   D. 7

6. Solve for x: x + 3 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 11
   C. 3
   D. 9

7. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 50
   C. 7
   D. 14

8. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 15
   C. 56
   D. 57

9. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 42
   C. 24
   D. 36

10. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 21
   C. 9
   D. 1

11. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 4

12. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 26
   C. 25
   D. 5

13. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 13
   C. 1
   D. 12

14. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 13
   C. 170
   D. 169

15. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 36
   D. 90

16. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 12
   C. 33
   D. 4

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
